summary: A member that trims locally captures only what judging the kinds it drops reads, instead of the whole store, and plans the same drop

schema.detail: No store table, index or claim schema change. A local cut's staging file has its own name and identity, and a scoped_envelopes table; full captures keep theirs.

rules.detail: No retention rule change. The scoped capture's plan equals a full capture's restricted to LOCAL_TRIM_KINDS (property test).

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. A citer is assumed accepted no more than an hour before what it cites.

downtime.detail: None. A local cut's capture reads and writes a fraction of what it did.

manual.detail: No manual step. A local staging file left by an older build is removed and captured again, scoped.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: local cuts capture the whole store again.
